tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ma sangs sprul pa stag sna rdzong pa'i byung tshul lo/ /'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sa skya ba/ /chol kha gsum la kha lo bsgyur pa'i dus/ /de'i 'phri
ma sangs sprul pa stag sna rdzong pa'i byung tshul lo/ /'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sa skya ba/ /chol kha gsum la kha lo bsgyur pa'i dus/ /de'i 'phri

tei:div.tei:p: ma sangs sprul pa stag sna rdzong pa'i byung tshul lo/ /

'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sa skya ba/ /chol kha gsum la kha lo bsgyur pa'i dus/ /de'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dpon chen dang*/ /slob dpon dge bshes blon rje rim pa rnams/ /mkhas pa mchog stobs grangs las 'das mod kyis | | thog mar yus po che ba'i mi gsum po/ /groms pas sa skya'i dpon rje shag bzang dang*/ /shar smad gtsong kha'i dge bshes rin brtson dang*/ mdo stod gon gyo'i hor chen don tshul yin/ /de gsum nang nas rigs mtho blo gsal ba | | dge bshes chen po nas brgyud ding sang bar/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog dbus gtsang bya ba dang*/ /mi mthun dpung 'joms ma sangs bka' babs zhes/ /snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs bcu kun khyab pa/ /blon chen 'di pa'i byon tshul 'di ltar ro/ /de yang 'di ltar thos te/ sngon bod du chos skyong rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang*/ de'i sras bzhi pa/ khri lde srong btsan rgyal po'i sku ring la/ mtha'i dmag 'gog pa'i bod yul gyi phyogs bzhir/ sgo ོ srung bskos/ khyed par bod dmag khri khrag mang po khyer nas/ bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcoms g.yul rgyal/ gnang 'aspyad klabacadablunas phyir byon dus/ de phyogs kyi sgau bsrung la/ bod dmag gseb nas skyen btus pa'i dpa' bo mi dgu dmag brgya phrag dgu dang bcas pa hor bod kyi so mtshams su gzhag de dus khong rnams kyi/ nged rnams ji tsam la log rgyu yin zhus pas/ rgyal po'i lung gi nged kyi bka' ma byung bar la log rgyu med gsungs pas/ de phyin pas dpa' bo mi dgu'i rus ling bka' ma log zer bar chags te/ der yun ring pas/ bka' ma log gi bod 'brog sde tshan mang po yod/ se chen rgyal po'i blon chen sang gha ching sang zer ba de'ang*/ rus bka' ma log tshang yin zer ba 'dug de rnams kyi chad rgyud las chad pa/ shar tsong kha mtsho sngon gyi mthil na/ skad gsar ba bya ba dang*/ bya rong ba bcu dgu mer bya ba dang*/

yul khams chen po gsum gyi bdag po yang zang ring mo'i sras che ba/ skya ming dbon po rin chen rgya mtshan zhes pa/ blo gsal zhing skye mched dwangs pa gcig byung ba/ de nyid gzhon nu nas dkar po'i phyogs la mos pa gcig yod pas/ yul khams rnams mched zla kun 'dzin du bcug nas/ gtsang sa skya bla ma'i snyan grags tshor/ mos gus bcug te/ zhabs la gtug par 'dod nas yar byon te/ mdo stod kyi hor chen ston tshul yang*/ chos don du gnyer ba la/ sngon la 'bri gung du byon/ der ma bsten/ sa skyar chas pa dang*/ khong rnams gnyis gya ba lung par mjal/ mdo stod smad kyi phyogs srid dang*/ sku tshe sngon ma'i 'brel shugs kyis/ spun phu nu ltar thugs shin tu mthun par byung nas/ de'i dbyar gya ba 'brong ngu dgon par bsdad/ ston de 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa gong nas yar phebs dus/ 'brong ngu dgon pa bas gdan drangs/ bsnyen bkur zhus/ de thog tu khong rnams gnyis pas kyang mjal/ rab byung zhus/ dbon po'i mtshan rin chen brtson 'grus bya bar btags | bdag slob gnyer mthil phyin pa gcig byed 'dod pas/ rjes su bzung du gsol zhus pas/ de bzhin legs/ slob dpon shar pa ye shes rin chen gyi slob gnyer gyi 'go 'don gyis la/ dge bshes chen po gcig mgyogs par yong bar byed do gsungs nas/ dge bshes la snga ba rin chen brtson 'grus zer ba'ang*/ de dus nas byung bar gda'o/ /de gnyis ka'i phyag phyir byon/ sa skyar phebs/ slob gnyer mdzad pas/ shes rab dang*/ thugs rus che ba'i tshad thub par byung nas/ ring por ma lon par sa skya'i dge bshes rnams kyi nang nas | mkhas grags thon par byung*/ bar skabs nas bla ma 'phags pa'i phyag phyi zhabs tog mthil bzhug phun ring mdzad/ bya ba'i ljid khur chen po mang du gal | de mtshams sa 'bri 'khrug pa'i 'go tshugs/ gong du khrims kyi gtug bsher la phyogs phyogs nas mi drag pa 'gro dgos pa byung dus/

dpon chen shākya bzang po dang*/ dge bshes rin chen brtson 'grus/ rin po che ston tshul gsum po'i bla ma dang*/ bstan pa gdan sa chen pos phyis la bsam te/ blos blangs nas byon/ khrims lugs su song bas/ tshal gung thang nas/ pho brang shang mtho'i bar la/ an khur nas rkang thang la byon/ gong du 'thug klagatugablubasher legs/ sa skya ba'i bya ba rnams la gang 'dod legs par grub nas/yar 'khor dus khong rnams sa skya ba la/ yus che ba'i mi gsum du grags par byung zhing*/ chen por gyur/ spyi sgaus su bla ma'i gnang sbyin/ brgya stong so so'i bya dga' chen po byas/ khyad par dge bshes chen po la/ ja rin la sa skya'i drug cha ma'i 'dab sgo dang*/ tshong dus khang leb kyi 'go byas/ grā sa khang ga ra phu'i gyog bzhis kha rnams gtsang mar gnang*/ skya btsun thams cad kyi bkur sti zhabs tog che bar byung*/ de'i skabs su mched grogs ston tshul ba'i gros la slob gnyer gyi bka' spyad byas/ dge bshes kyi snyan grags ni thob/ sa skyas gsang sngags zab mo'i bdag po yin pas/ da yang gsang sngags dang mthun par mdzad na sku khams kyi mtsho skyong du'ang 'gyur la/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ bu slob rjes 'dzin sogs la'ang khyad 'phye klacheblubar yong zer ba la gsan nas nyang stong byed mda' ba/ ma cig mkha' 'gro 'bum mngon chung ngus gyog gzhis ka ru gzhag phyag rgya bsten pa la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba ban rgan blo gros rin chen/ bar pa dharma dkon mchog chung pa dpon kun dga' rdo rje rnams byung*| bar pa 'di 'gro 'gon phyag na'i sras/ dharma pha la rakṣi ta dang*/ lo zla zhag dus mnyam du 'khrungs pa na/ mtshan 'di chos rgyal 'phags pas btags par byed do/ /de'i dus su rgyal bu chos dpal/ bod 'chos pa la byon pas/ bsu skyel zhabs taug la dge bshes chen po de bas/ 'bad rtsol skyes pas/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas phyir byon dus/

swags sā mdo bar skyel thung la byon par rgyal bu mnyes nas/ byang re thag phyir than gang 'dug/rin chen brtson 'grus mi rgyud dang bcas pa shes su 'phyug klachugablucing*/ khyed kyi shed mong 'dab pa bzhin du bu tsha bo rnams kyis kyang*/ gong ma yon mchod la shed mong 'dab chug zer ba'i/ ming byi bzang po gnang*/de nas dge bshes chen po/ sa skya'i tshong dus khang leb tu zhi bar gshegs rting*/ sras che ba ban rgan pas/ yab kyi rjes su zhugs nas khrims kyi bya ba dang*/ sa skya ba'i zhabs tog nang so'i mthil len/ dgos su bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs la gtug shed mong gdabs/ lta tu'i pho brang du byon pas/ bla ma'i sku drin la/ o la bya du rgyal po'i lung lha rgod mdung rtse yan nas/ dwangs ra g.yu mtsho man 'di/ blo gros rin chen rgyud pa dang bcas pa shes su bcug pa'i 'jags sa gtsang ma gnang*/ gcung gnyis po nye ring med par bskyangs| gcen la byang gi khri dpon dang*/ gcung la du dben shī'i las kha zhus nas bskos/ dharma dkon mchog gi gzhis pa la/ ma cig khro 'bum gyi nye gnas ma gcig dang*/ dpon kun rdo rje la ma cig bsod 'bum gyi tsha mo gcig blangs nas/ gnyis ka la sras ma byung*/ ban rgan pas zhal ta mdzad/ zhal ta ma re re 'og tu bzhag pa las/ khri dpon dharma dkon mchog la sras khri dpon chos rgya dang*/dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po byung*/ du dben sha kun dga' rdo rje la sras/ khri dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan byung*/ khri dpon chos rgyal gyis/ yab kyi shul du byang ru'i khri dpon thog gcig mdzad nas sku gshegs so/ /sras med pas dkon mchog rgyal mtshan khri dpon la bskos/ bla chen kun blo'i phyag phyir gong la byon/ yar jau mo sreg shing dbon mo bslangs nas| mthong smon sa cha/ lha khang spang grong gi kha 'dzin byed dus/ sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba dpon po dkon mchog 'od zer dang*/

dkon mchog rin chen/ mkhan po bsod nams blo gros/ chung pa rgod po rin chen rnams byung ngo*/ /gcung po 'di ma sangs kyi sprul pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di' ི skabs su dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po de nyid/ 'brog khri skor gyi ru thog mtsho mo ru khyung gi skor nas sgar chen bzhugs dus/ 'a phyibs klachibs blugar ston chen bya ba gcig bor nas/ lha 'dre mi gsum la lca hu bkrams/ rtsad gcod pa phyogs bzhir btang bas/ shar phyogs pa mi gnyis kyis kha ba skya sribs babs pa'i steng la rta rjes 'dug pa| mthar dad pas sog la skya bo'i zhol na/ sgar chen gcig 'dug de'i khrod na chibs pa yang 'dug nas/ mgron mnyer ba la rgyu mtshan bshad/ sgar 'di sus yin bris pas/ ma sangs gyi sgar yin/ ge sar dang rgu ld-i la sogs pa yod zer/ gur nang du khrid/ rgu ld-i yin zer ba de na re/ nged kyi kha sing nas byang stong la yong*/ dpon chen pa dang mjal rtsis la ma mjal/ da gzod khyed kyi dpon po gcig yod pa de dang*/ yang yang 'phrad zer ba gyis la/ rta dang mda' rgo sgro ma 'di phul zer nas khyer yong*/ dpon chen pa la phul| der rting dpon po rgod po rin chen 'khrungs so/ /dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po de nyid/ ti shri kun rgyal ba'i zhabs la gtug gong la phyag phyir byon| bla ma'i sku drin dang*/ khrims kyi bya ba la mkhas pas/ sngon la dban shri dang*/ der rting du dbus gtsang gi dpon chen sngun ma thob/ yar phebs dus rgan pas zhal ta mdzad/ jo mor bla ma mus chen po'i dbon mo dang*/ dpon mo jo mo rim par blangs na'ang*/ sras ma byung ba/ zhal ta ma 'bum rgyan bya ba la sras grags pa rgyal mtshan pa byung zhing*/ rting la sras zur ru dpon po hor tsha bya ba gcig yang byung*/ dpon chen pas dbon po dkon mchog 'od zer byang khri dpon la bskos/ sras po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa sa skya nang sor bzhag dbus gtsang bde ba la bkod nas/

dbon po dkon mchog rin chen pa phyag phyir khrid te/ yang gong ma yon mchod kyi zhabs drung du byon pa/ sngan rting dril bas lo bco brgyad tsam gong du bzhugs/ swaun bying dben gyi rtsa ba'i dpon chen lo zhang lan gsum mdzad/ lung gu ta ha'i zon gnang*/ yar 'byon khar nga'i ru ber khyung gsum gyi tshong pa/ bod la lo lo bzhin yong ba'i 'babs sa'i gnas gzhi gcig brtsigs dgos zhus pas/ gang 'os tshol gsungs pa la| shangs na dbe mar sgang rgyud nas sa che bar 'dug pas 'di dgos zhus pas/ gye re babs la gdong yan/ thag ya ngal gdong*/ nyang ri shi cig man gyi sa cha/ rgyal ba bzang po'i rta sga 'bogs la byin cing*/ de khongs gang bos su gnas gzhi brtsig du 'phyug klachugablugasungs pa'i lung bzang po gnang bas/ yar phebs nas shangs mthong smon gyi sa cha 'di na | klu gnas pa'i rdzing gcig 'dug pas/ ming dang gang sa nas rten 'brel la legs pas/ 'di khongs su phyug pa gyis gsungs lcags ri/ dpe lcog rnams kyi dkyil du khang leb chen mo dang bcas par btab/ der rting gong ma yon mchod kyi sku rim smon lam 'deb cing*/ spos bsregs pa'i lha khang gcig bzhengs su bcug dgos zer ba'i zhu ba gong du btang bas/ de bzhin yin chug gsungs pa'i lung phebs nas| nyug rgyal khang rgyal po'i pho brang la dpe blangs pa bzhengs/ chos sde 'di blon bod rgyal blon bzhugs dus kyi bka' stsal rnying pa dang*/ ram sding ma bas dgon lag rnying pa dar cha med pa cig 'dug pa'ang*/ dpon chen pas rgyal khang bzhengs pa dang mnyam du/ sā paṇḍi ta 'jigs med grags pa/ chosadapon la gdan drangs/ dgos kyi mnga' zhabs la btsun khral thengs gnyis rgyab nas bshad grwa btsugs/ chos sde'i shedamong skyed/ chos khrims dar bar mdzad cing*/ yab yum gyi phyi bstan la/ g.ya' dmar dgang stod du/ sku 'bum chen mo bzhengs/ zha lu bu ston rin po che gdan drangs nas/

rab gnas dbus gtsang du rgyas pa'i dpe thub pa mdzad/ lung gi bskaus pa'i dpon chen gnyis/ byang sa'i phyag tshab gcig dang bcas pas/ gong du dbus gtsang dang*/ dpon chen thengs gsum mdzad pas/ de bar la gdan sa chen mo'i zhabs tog bla ma la bkur bsti/ mnga' zhabs kyi skyong thar/ phag gru khri dpon dang*/ khams pa la sogs khrims 'gal mu med byed mi rnams la/ drag las kyi 'jun 'dul/ gzhan yang rgyal khrims chen po'i bya ba la'ang*/ nye ring med cing blang dor ma 'dzol bar byung pas/ kun gyi byang chub sems dpa'i dpon chen du grags shing*/ gong nas rting ma phebs rjes la/ sras blo gros rgyal mtshan pa byung ba/ gcen dpon chen grags rgyal dang*/ dgung lo bcu bdun bco brgyad kyi khyad yod pas na/ grags rgyal ba'i sras yin par byed pa yang yod la/ khong gnyis kyi bar du dpon po hor tshas dpon thog tu lo gcig gnyis bzhugs zer ba'ang gleng*/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po bas/ khrims gnyis kyi bya ba dpon chen dbang brtson la 'phrod pa'i skabs su/ lha rtse'i gzim khang lho mar bde bar gshegs nas/ spur bzhu dus/ thugs thugs thag dang bcas te byon pa deng*/ gzim khang gung rigs la/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku 'dra yod pa| de'i thugs khar thim pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub bo/ /phyis skor gyi dpon chen la/ 'di nyid bla ma la gus zhing khrims gnyis kyi bya ba la mkhas par byed do/ /dpon chen pas sras po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas/ sngon sa skya nang chen bzung*/ rting la dpon chen gyi ming thob/ shang mthong smon bzung ba'i skabs der sku gshegs so/ /gcung po dpon po hor tsha'i sras/ sna dkrar ba dpon kun dga' rgyal po rgyud chad/ blo gros rgyal mtshan pas/ sī tu'i ming dang las ka thob/ dpon chen pas dbon po 'di dang*/ mthong smon sbrags nas ti sī tu byang chub rgyal mtshan la skrad/ gtsang phyogs kyi sde pa dar lcog dkar po 'dzugs pa'i sngon ma byas zer ba 'duga'adi'

ི ring la mthong smon pad chen bzhengs/ sgo pad zur lcaug rnams kyi kha bsgron/ 'obs lcags chung gsos so/ /de'i sras bzhi pa'i che ba du dben sha byang chub rgyal ba dpal bzang po'ang*/ ldog thung du grags pa/ thugs rgod cing 'artsom brkyan klartsal skyenablupas/ de'i ring la rdzong shang dang*/ phyi nang gi sde 'khrug mang*/ de 'og mkhan po kun dga' blo gros pas/ nyug chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad/ de 'og tu dben sha kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas/ rgyal mthong bzung kun dang mthun pa'i lugs shas che bar byung*/ gcung po chung ba dpon po kun dga' rdo rje bas| du dban sha kun rgyal bas gdung rgyud lcam mo blang ba la sras gcig 'khrungs pa/ du dben sha rin chen rgyal po sku brtan par bzhugs pa'o/ khri dpon dkon mchog 'od zer bas byang ru thog gi khri dpon mdzad cing*| dpon po dkon mchog rin chen dang*/ rgod po rin chen pas/ nyug rgyal khang mgo byas/ bres sna la sogs 'dzin/ mkhan po bsod nams blo gros pas zhang po'i gdan sa sreg shing gi mkhan po mdzad pa'i dus su/ 'thon mkhan po yang klamathong smon na yangablu/ dpon chen grags rgyal ba yod pas/ dpon skya g.yog rigs ky-i dbang du song nas shangs pa nang ma bde/ dpon po kun mched che ba gnyis sku gshegs rting dpon po rgod po rin chen pas/ stag tshang rdzong khar bla chen bsod blo sku mched pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ rgyab bcol nas rdzong blang sde gsar rgyun ring*/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la bla chen gyi phyag phyir mkhan chen g.yas ru pas byas nas/ gong la byon bla ma'i bka' drin la/ tho gon thi mur rgyal pos/ phing gcig pa'i mi dpon srid swan bying dban gyi hu shri'i mtshan dang*/ dam rtags/

ban rgan blo gros rin chen pas dus su/ ji ltar gnang ba bzhin gyi bod 'brog dbang rigs rnams/ rgod po rin chen du hu shri mi rgyud dang bcas pa shes su chug gsungs pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang*| yar phebs bla ma sku mched pas zhabs tog sde pa stag tshang rdzong ka'i phyi'i dgra 'dul dmag dpon gyi bya ba gang la'ang*/ sde pa'i mtshan byus gtso bor ston pas/ dpon sa nas kyang thag rta nag gi gnyer pa gnang*/ sna dmar rdzong brtsigs/ shangs pa nang ltar gyi sde gsar 'pho 'jug mang na'ang phyi nang sus kyang rgol bar ma nus pa/ rgod pa'i snyan grags shin du che zhing*/ me pho stag lo rdzong stag sna don grub rtse bzung ste/ de'i char gtaugs pa'i mnga' zhabs bod 'brog mang du chod nas/ da lta'i bar la brtan cing 'phel ba dang bcas pa'o/ /de la yum mi gcig pa'i sras bu gsum byung pa'i che ba/ rta nag pa dpon po shā kya rin chen/ chung ba skyor mo ba sog po rin chen rnams te/ shā kya rin chen pas/ yab kyi gnyer las kyi rjes rta nag bzung*/ de la sras dug tsher rin chen dang*/ nam mkha' rin chen/ dge sbyong dkar por grags pa rnams so/ /rgyal ba rin chen la sras/ rnam rgyal rin chen dang*/ dpal ldan rin chen byung*/ gnyis kha yab kyi sngon la 'das so// sog po rin chen pas/ lha bu rin mkhar zer 'gong laklakhong lamablurdzong gsar brtsigs/ sras rgyal bu rin chen pa dang*/ dge sbyong bsod nams rin chen pa/ grags pa rin chen pa rnams byung ngo*/ khri dpon dkon mchog 'od zer ba/ sku mched phyogs gcig pa'i dus kyi sras po gcig byung ba/ drung chen glang po rin chen de nyid/ yab grongs pa'i rjes la stag tshang rdzong khar 'khrungs/ dpon po dang bla brang dang*/ mtsho skyong 'go 'don yang dag mdzad/ cher skyes nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas zhal mthong*/ dbang rnam sras pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ gzim dpon mdzad|

khu dbon phyogs gcig tu dril nas dgra 'dul 'asnyanaklaganyen bluskyong | dpon po'i zhabs tog bu 'arta'i rum klaru ba bluskyong thar/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la shin tu mkhas shing*/ thugs rtsol che bar grags pas phyogs kun tu khyab po/ khyad par dbus pa bdag po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas phag mo gru ba'i srid la gtogs pa'i dbus gtsang gi dmag dpung stobs che ba bsdus nas/ me pho khyi lo'i ston stag sna rdzong la bskor rgyag yun ring byas/ nang yan 'tshag skyel bred sdig ji snyed cig byung na'ang*/ yab sras dpon g.yog rnams kyi legs par sra bcas/ 'phra phur tshur/ 'thab srol sprad pas dbus gtsang du mkhraigs pa'i tshad thub pa byung zhing*/ stag shar gtsang srid du grags pa'i mgo de nas tshugs par yin/ sa skya ba'i srid byus yar 'phel du song pa blon chen de nyid kyis thugs zhen dang*/ 'phrin las la brten pa'o/ / de'i sras lnga'i che ba/ drung chen nam kha' rin chen pa ni/ sku gzhon nu nas klaug yig la sogs bslab shes kyi yon tan mtha' dag sngon du phyogs nas/ mi dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ me pho ho shri chen po'i zhabs la gtugs/ gsol ja bzung*/ pho rtsal sna dgu skur skyong 'grogs lam sde srid 'dzin pa'i bya ba la yon tan 'argor mar klasgor morablu'adzoms pas kun gyi ma 'bazang klasangasablukyi sprul par 'dzin cing*| khyad par khyi lo dmag chen gyi lo rdzong gi rtse zhol bsrung ba gang khag pa thams cad du phebs nas/ gyogs mda' rdo'i gnad sprad pas shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur te/ phyis nas gdong len gyi mi su yang med pa byung ngo*| |gzhan yang dmag che chung mtha' rogs snga phyi mang po'i 'go ma la byon pa | dus nam yang gdong phud ngor lang kho na mdzad cing*/ phyi skor bya ba gang la'ang*/ brtan lhing gtsau bor 'don pas/ phyi nang kun gyis 'di ni dpa' mdzangs 'dzoms pa'i skyes bu chen po yin zhes grags so/

/de'i gcung po rgya bzang rin chen/ rgyal mtsho rin chen/ nor bu rin chen/ grub pa rin chen rnams yin/ gcung 'di'i rdzong rab 'a'abyor kla'abyonablurtse bzung*/ mtshar zhan bod 'brog kun gsar du chod do/ /gcen gyi khab tu gdung rgyud lcam mo/ byang sems nam mkha' rgyal po ba byon pa'i sras che ba chos rgyal rin chen mched gsum te/ sku mched khu dbon zhal ngo mang la rags pa/ sku brtan par bzhugs pa lags so/ /blon chen che rgyud ma 'bazang klasangasablusprul pa'i rigs/ kha grag mi dpung 'dzoms pa 'khor bcas 'dis/ /phas rgol mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba dang*/ /dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas gyur cig / dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /pho rtsal sna dgu ni theb kyi sha non pa dang gcig rkyal gyi chu non pa/ yang sor bya lta bu dang gsum la dpa' shad lus kyi rtsal gsum zer/ lo rgyus kyi dge yon thon pa dang*/ 'gran shags kyi lce non pa dang*/ khyom tshos 'gazhar klabazhadablugad thon pa dang gsum la smra ba ngag gi rtsal gsum zer/ dpa' la brtan tshugs pa dang gcig mdzangs la blo myur ba dang gnyis/ go gsal la gting sus kyang mi rtaugs pa dag gsum la| blo gros sems kyi rtsal gsum zer/ pho rtsal sna dgu ni/ mda' rdo mchongs gsum| sho phras brtsigs gsum/ bang shags rkyal gsum dang dgu'o/ /pho rtsal sna dgu 'di 'dzom na ma 'bazang klasangasablusprul par byed do/ / mes po'i shul bzhag rgya bod yig tshang chen mo/stag sna rdzong pa'i byung tshul/ -PAGE 232--PAGE 233-
